items.quote: Then Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed
items.claim: Abraham fell on his face and laughed

items.quote: Shall a child be born unto him that is an hundred years old? and shall Sarah, that is ninety years old, bear?
items.claim: Abraham doubted whether conception could occur at their advanced ages

items.quote: And Abraham said unto God, O that Ishmael might live before thee!
items.claim: Abraham expressed a desire that Ishmael might live before God

items.quote: Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed
items.claim: Sarah shall bear a son to Abraham

items.quote: thou shalt call his name Isaac
items.claim: Abraham shall name his son Isaac

items.quote: I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his seed after him
items.claim: God will establish an everlasting covenant with the son and his descendants
